## Prime-Agent System Prompt (ACP Template)

For file editing operations, the prime-agent runtime exposes a pre-installed `mcp` Python object with `list_tools` and `call_tool` methods. Use them to discover and invoke tools.

Example discovery and call:

```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
for t in tools_list:
    print(t["name"], t["inputSchema"])

result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/tmp/x.py", "content": "# code here"})
print(result)
```

The `tools` MCP server exposes:
- `ox-bridge-write`: write a file (args: `path`, `content`)
- `ox-bridge-edit`: edit a file with hunks (args: `path`, `edits` = [{old, new}])
- `ox-bridge-read`: read a file region (args: `path`, `start`, `end`)

All bridging calls return synchronously. Print results to confirm before proceeding.

Generate a semantic, accessible landing page from data and verify its structure with a Node HTML parser instead of eyeballing it. /workspace/landing: src/build.js takes a site config object (title, nav links, hero heading and copy, three feature cards each with an icon alt text, footer links) and returns a full HTML string using header, nav with aria-label, main, exactly one h1, section per feature block with h2s, figure/img with non-empty alt, and footer with a contentinfo landmark implied by the element. A build script writes dist/index.html. Tests with vitest and node-html-parser: exactly one h1, heading levels never skip, every img has non-empty alt, nav contains all configured links with correct hrefs, no inline event-handler attributes anywhere. Run the build then npx vitest run; both must succeed.

  • ${esc(l.label)}
    • `) .join('\n'); const featureSections = features .map( (f) => `

    ${esc(f.title)}

    ${esc(f.body)}

    ` ) .join('\n'); const footerItems = footerLinks.length ? `
      ${footerLinks .map((l) => `
    • ${esc(l.label)}
      • `) .join('\n')}
    ` : ''; return ` ${esc(title)}
      ${navItems}

    ${esc(heroHeading)}

    ${esc(heroCopy)}

    ${featureSections}

    ${esc(footerCopy)}

    ${footerItems}
    `; } function slug(text) { return String(text) .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-') .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); } module.exports = { buildLandingPage };
